name_cn: 济宁艾美服装服饰有限公司
main_products: Down jackets, outdoor shell jackets, cotton-padded coats
woven_evidence: It is a contract maker of down, padded and shell jackets, which use woven shell fabrics.

canton_fair.evidence_note: The Jining commerce bureau's 136th fair general booth notice lists 济宁艾美服装服饰有限公司 under Men's & Women's Wear (男女装) with 5 booths.

notes: Chinese media (news.sina.cn 2022; pai.com.cn) describe a factory started in 2003 in Jiaxiang with 1,000+ employees and village satellite workshops, selling through Alibaba International. No English name, website or B2B URL was confirmed, so Layer 2 should find them.
